items.title: Man accidentally gains control of 7k robot vacuums
items.raw_content: Sammy Azdoufal just wanted to steer his DJI Romo with a gaming controller.
items.title_zh: 男子意外控制约 7000 台扫地机器人
items.summary: Sammy Azdoufal wanted to steer his DJI Romo robot vacuum with a gaming controller, and according to the report he accidentally gained control of roughly 7,000 vacuums.

items.title: Qwen3.5: Towards Native Multimodal Agents
items.raw_content: Qwen offers comprehensive functionality spanning chatbot, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search integration, tool utilization, and artifacts.
items.title_zh: Qwen3.5：迈向原生多模态智能体
items.summary: Qwen3.5 is presented as a move toward native multimodal agents, with capabilities listed for chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: Gemini 3.1 Pro
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.1 Pro
items.summary: Google published a Gemini 3.1 Pro announcement alongside a Vertex AI preview and a model card from Google DeepMind.

items.title: CXMT has been offering DDR4 chips at about half the prevailing market rate
items.raw_content: Samsung Electronics and SK hynix are locked in a race to mass-produce sixth-generation high-bandwidth memory, but Chinese rivals are making gains elsewhere — fl
items.title_zh: CXMT 正以约为市场价一半的价格供应 DDR4 芯片
items.summary: Samsung and SK hynix are racing to mass-produce sixth-generation high-bandwidth memory while Chinese rivals make gains elsewhere, according to the report. It says CXMT has been offering DDR4 chips at about half the prevailing market rate.

items.title: Nvidia and OpenAI abandon unfinished $100B deal in favour of $30B investment
items.title_zh: 英伟达与 OpenAI 放弃未完成的 1000 亿美元协议，转向 300 亿美元投资
items.summary: According to the report, Nvidia and OpenAI have abandoned an unfinished $100 billion deal in favour of a $30 billion investment.

items.summary: Google published a Gemini 3.1 Pro announcement alongside a Vertex AI preview and a model card from Google DeepMind.

items.title: CXMT has been offering DDR4 chips at about half the prevailing market rate

items.summary: Samsung and SK hynix are racing to mass-produce sixth-generation high-bandwidth memory while Chinese rivals make gains elsewhere, according to the report. It says CXMT has been offering DDR4 chips at about half the prevailing market rate.

items.title: Nvidia and OpenAI abandon unfinished $100B deal in favour of $30B investment
items.title_zh: 英伟达与 OpenAI 放弃未完成的 1000 亿美元协议，转向 300 亿美元投资
items.summary: According to the report, Nvidia and OpenAI have abandoned an unfinished $100 billion deal in favour of a $30 billion investment.

items.title: "Token anxiety", a slot machine by any other name
items.title_zh: “Token 焦虑”，不过是换了名字的老虎机
items.summary: The author responds to a Bluesky post about "token anxiety," describing a creeping dread fed by constant use of coding agents such as Claude Code.

items.title: Show HN: Glitchy camera – a circuit-bent camera simulator in the browser
items.title_zh: Show HN：Glitchy camera——浏览器里的电路弯折相机模拟器
items.summary: A Show HN side project simulates circuit-bent CCD cameras in the browser, letting users rewire pin pairs and turn knobs to produce glitch effects in real time and save photos. The developer says it was built from scratch with GPT-5.3-Codex, which required frequent code cleanup and hand-holding.

items.title: Gentoo on Codeberg
items.title_zh: Gentoo 进驻 Codeberg
items.summary: Gentoo now has a presence on Codeberg, where contributions can be submitted to a repository mirror as an alternative to GitHub, as part of a gradual mirror migration described in its 2025 end-of-year review.

items.title: 15 years later, Microsoft morged my diagram
items.title_zh: 15 年后，微软又把我的图“合并”了
items.summary: The author reflects on how Microsoft has continued to "merge" his Git branching diagram over the 15 years since he published it.

items.title: Terminals should generate the 256-color palette
items.title_zh: 终端应当自行生成 256 色调色板
items.summary: A GitHub Gist argues that terminals should generate the 256-color palette themselves.

items.title: Blue light filters don't work – controlling total luminance is a better bet
items.title_zh: 蓝光滤镜没用，控制总亮度才是更好的办法
items.summary: A visual neuroscientist argues that blue light filters do not work, and that controlling total light intake is a more useful way to improve sleep and reduce jet lag.

items.title: Show HN: A native macOS client for Hacker News, built with SwiftUI
items.title_zh: Show HN：用 SwiftUI 写的原生 macOS Hacker News 客户端
items.summary: A developer has open-sourced, under the MIT license, a native macOS Hacker News client built with SwiftUI. It uses a split-view layout with a story sidebar, an integrated reader and comment threading, and blocks 14 major ad networks.

items.title: How Taalas “prints” LLM onto a chip?
items.title_zh: Taalas 如何把 LLM“印”到芯片上？
items.summary: A startup called Taalas has released an ASIC that runs Llama 3.1 8B, quantized to 3/6 bits, at about 17,000 tokens per second, according to this blog post. The author says Taalas hardwires the model's weights into the chip and claims roughly 10x lower ownership cost, 10x lower electricity use and about 10x faster inference than GPU-based systems.

items.title: How I use Claude Code: Separation of planning and execution
items.title_zh: 我如何使用 Claude Code：规划与执行分离
items.summary: The author describes the research-plan-implement workflow he uses to build software with Claude Code, and explains why he does not let it write code until a written plan has been approved.

items.title: Xweather Live – Interactive global vector weather map
items.title_zh: Xweather Live：交互式全球矢量天气地图
items.summary: An interactive global weather map offering real-time radar, forecasts, air quality, wind speeds and severe weather alerts, plus AI-generated summaries of weather impacts.

items.title: 14-year-old Miles Wu folded origami pattern that holds 10k times its own weight
items.title_zh: 14 岁的 Miles Wu 折出可承受自重 1 万倍的折纸结构
items.summary: Miles Wu, 14, folded a variant of the Miura-ori pattern that can hold 10,000 times its own weight, according to Smithsonian Magazine.

items.title: Google Public CA is down
items.title_zh: Google Public CA 发生故障
items.summary: Google's status page reported an incident affecting Google Public CA that began at 11:18 and ended at 21:04 US/Pacific on 2026-02-17, and said the fix had been rolled out.

items.title: A terminal weather app with ASCII animations driven by real-time weather data
items.title_zh: 由实时天气数据驱动的 ASCII 动画终端天气应用
items.summary: weathr is a terminal weather app on GitHub that renders ASCII animations driven by real-time weather data.

items.title: Gamedate – A site to revive dead multiplayer games
items.title_zh: Gamedate：让已停服的多人游戏重获新生
items.summary: Gamedate lets players schedule sessions for dead games, niche mods and retro netplay, and says no account is needed.

items.title: Apple to hold spring launch event in China on March 4
items.title_zh: 苹果将于 3 月 4 日在中国举行春季发布会
items.summary: Apple said it will hold its spring product launch event in Shanghai on March 4, marking the first time the iPhone maker has staged such an event.

items.title: Humanoid robots take center stage at 2026 Spring Festival Gala, revealing China’s latest robotics advances
items.title_zh: 人形机器人登上 2026 年春晚舞台，展现中国机器人最新进展
items.summary: Several robotics companies showcased their latest research and development progress, including humanoid robots, at China's 2026 CCTV Spring Festival Gala.

items.title: Moore Threads completes full adaptation of Qwen3.5 model
items.title_zh: 摩尔线程完成 Qwen3.5 模型全面适配
items.summary: Moore Threads, a Chinese GPU maker, says it has fully adapted Alibaba's latest open-source large language model, Qwen3.5.

items.title: Blades of the Guardians uses Seedance 2.0 to assist in end-credit Easter Egg
items.title_zh: 《Blades of the Guardians》借助 Seedance 2.0 制作片尾彩蛋
items.summary: According to TechNode, Blades of the Guardians used Seedance 2.0 to assist with an end-credit Easter egg.

items.title: Unitree CEO says robot capability comparable to 10-year-old, large-scale use 3–5 years away
items.title_zh: 宇树 CEO：机器人能力相当于 10 岁儿童，大规模应用还需 3 至 5 年
items.summary: Unitree Robotics founder Wang Xingxing said the current level of robotics technology is comparable to that of a 10-year-old child, according to TechNode. He added that large-scale use is still three to five years away.

items.title: Kamingo electric kit transforms traditional bicycles into smart, power-assisted rides for flexible urban cycling
items.title_zh: Kamingo 电动改装套件：让传统自行车变身智能助力车
items.summary: TechNode looks at Kamingo, an electric kit that turns traditional bicycles into smart, power-assisted rides, as e-bikes gain popularity for commuting, leisure and short-distance travel.

items.title: Gentleman-Programming/engram
items.title_zh: Gentleman-Programming/engram——AI 编程智能体的持久记忆系统
items.summary: Engram is a persistent memory system for AI coding agents, shipped as an agent-agnostic Go binary with SQLite and FTS5, an MCP server, HTTP API, CLI and TUI.

items.title: AgriciDaniel/claude-blog
items.title_zh: AgriciDaniel/claude-blog
items.summary: A Claude Code blog skill suite with 30 sub-skills and five agents, built around a five-gate “Blog Delivery Contract” and optimized for both Google rankings and AI citations.

items.title: Auriti-Labs/geo-optimizer-skill
items.title_zh: geo-optimizer-skill：开源的 GEO 优化引擎
items.summary: The open-source engine behind GeoReady, usable as a CLI, Python package and MCP server, audits whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews cite a given site.

items.title: IRNova/Nova-Proxy
items.title_zh: Nova-Proxy：多平台代理订阅图形面板
items.summary: Nova-Proxy is a graphical panel for delivering Worker subscriptions with Trojan and Warp proxies, along with proxy chaining, full DNS settings, clean IP selection and advanced routing. It supports Amnezia, WireGuard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores across platforms.

items.title: olvvier/apple-silicon-accelerometer
items.title_zh: apple-silicon-accelerometer：读取 Apple Silicon MacBook 的隐藏加速度计与陀螺仪
items.summary: The Python project reads the undocumented MEMS accelerometer and gyroscope in Apple Silicon MacBooks through IOKit HID.

items.title: vava-nessa/free-coding-models
items.title_zh: vava-nessa/free-coding-models：170 多个免费编程模型的命令行入口
items.summary: The project offers a CLI to find, benchmark and install more than 170 free coding LLM models from over 15 providers in real time.

items.title: vmoranv/jshookmcp
items.title_zh: vmoranv/jshookmcp：面向 AI 智能体的逆向工程工作区 MCP 服务器
items.summary: jshookmcp is a search-first, profile-aware reverse-engineering workspace for AI agents that bundles 735 tools across 36 domains in a single MCP server; it is written in TypeScript.

items.title: wanikua/danghuangshang
items.title_zh: wanikua/danghuangshang：开源多智能体协作系统
items.summary: An open-source multi-agent collaboration system inspired by Chinese governance that uses OpenClaw to deploy and coordinate specialized AI agents.

items.title: Xiangyu-CAS/xiaohongshu-ops-skill
items.title_zh: Xiangyu-CAS/xiaohongshu-ops-skill——把 Openclaw 变成小红书运营助手
items.summary: This skill turns Openclaw into a Xiaohongshu operations assistant for analysis, topic selection, content creation, review and replication, and even full account management.

items.title: nextlevelbuilder/goclaw
items.title_zh: nextlevelbuilder/goclaw：用 Go 重写的 OpenClaw
items.summary: GoClaw is OpenClaw rebuilt in Go, with multi-tenant isolation, a five-layer security model and native concurrency, aimed at deploying AI agent teams at scale.

items.title: Whisper: Courtside Edition Enhancing ASR Performance Through LLM-Driven Context Generation
items.title_zh: Whisper：Courtside Edition——用 LLM 驱动上下文生成提升 ASR 性能
items.summary: The paper introduces Whisper: Courtside Edition, a multi-agent LLM pipeline that improves OpenAI Whisper transcriptions without retraining by generating compact prompts that guide the decoder. On 421 NBA commentary segments, the best pipeline achieved a 17.0% relative reduction in word error rate, from 0.217 to 0.180.

items.title: A Scan-Based Analysis of Internet-Exposed IoT Devices Using Shodan Data
items.title_zh: 基于 Shodan 数据的互联网暴露 IoT 设备扫描分析
items.summary: An analysis of internet-exposed IoT endpoints uses a controlled multi-country sample of 100 hosts identified through TCP port 7547, enriched with Shodan metadata. It finds consistent cross-country differences in exposure structure, with mean risky-port counts of 0.4 to 1.0 per host and balanced accuracy of about 0.61 when classifying higher-risk profiles.

items.title: Updating Parametric Knowledge with Context Distillation Retains Post-Training Capabilities
items.title_zh: 用上下文蒸馏更新参数知识可保留后训练能力
items.summary: The paper introduces Distillation via Split Contexts (DiSC), which conditions student and teacher distributions on distinct segments of a training example and minimizes KL divergence between shared tokens, reporting the best trade-off between learning new knowledge and retaining instruction-following, reasoning and factual knowledge across four post-trained models.

items.title: Machine Learning Based Prediction of Surgical Outcomes in Chronic Rhinosinusitis from Clinical Data
items.title_zh: 基于临床数据的慢性鼻窦炎手术结果机器学习预测
items.summary: Using prospectively collected data from an observational trial, the authors trained supervised models to predict surgical benefit in chronic rhinosinusitis from preoperative data and SNOT-22 outcomes. The best model reached about 85% classification accuracy and 80% on a held-out set of 30 cases, above the 75.6% average for expert clinicians.

items.title: INDUCTION: Finite-Structure Concept Synthesis in First-Order Logic
items.title_zh: INDUCTION：一阶逻辑中的有限结构概念合成
items.summary: The paper introduces INDUCTION, a benchmark for finite-structure concept synthesis in first-order logic in which models must output a single formula that explains a target predicate across small relational worlds, verified by exact model checking. It reports sharp difficulty gradients and finds that low-bloat formulas generalize better to held-out worlds.

items.title: Time Series, Vision, and Language: Exploring the Limits of Alignment in Contrastive Representation Spaces
items.title_zh: 时间序列、视觉与语言：对比表征空间中对齐的边界
items.summary: The authors find that independently pretrained time series, vision and language encoders are near-orthogonal without explicit coupling, and that post-hoc contrastive alignment improves with model size but is asymmetric — time series align more strongly with visual representations than with text, and images can act as intermediaries.

items.title: Quantifying LLM Attention-Head Stability: Implications for Circuit Universality
items.title_zh: 量化 LLM 注意力头稳定性：对电路普适性的启示
items.summary: The study measures how consistently attention heads learn representations across independently initialized training runs, finding that middle-layer heads are the least stable yet most representationally distinct, that weight decay substantially improves stability, and that the residual stream is comparatively stable.

items.title: Understanding Unreliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models: Geometric Predictors and the Limits of Linear Approximations
items.title_zh: 理解语言模型引导向量的不可靠性：几何预测因子与线性近似的局限
items.summary: The thesis studies why steering vectors are reliable for some behaviors but not others, finding that higher cosine similarity between training activation differences and better separation of positive and negative activations predict reliability. It concludes steering breaks down when the target behavior is not well approximated by a linear direction.

items.title: Noise Scheduling as Information-Guided Allocation in Diffusion Training
items.title_zh: 把噪声调度看作信息引导的分配：扩散训练中的 InfoNoise
items.summary: InfoNoise is an online adaptive noise schedule for diffusion training that estimates a conditional-entropy-rate profile from denoising losses and shifts optimization toward the most informative noise levels, without auxiliary models or offline search. It matches or slightly beats strong baselines on image benchmarks and reaches target quality with up to 3x less training compute under distribution shifts.

items.title: Detector-in-the-Loop Tracking: Active Memory Rectification for Stable Glottic Opening Localization
items.title_zh: 检测器在环跟踪：主动记忆校正实现稳定的声门开放定位
items.summary: The authors propose Closed-Loop Memory Correction, a detector-in-the-loop framework that supervises SAM2 with confidence-aligned state decisions and semantic resets that overwrite corrupted tracker memory. On emergency intubation videos it reduced drift and missing rates compared with SAM2 variants and open-loop methods.
